title: The bracket arm A': the same 4-member committee vs one 8B-Q4_K_M that is SMALLER than the committee
author: mac-codex
origin: equal-budget-002 pre-registered this exact arm as `arm_a.bracket` and then did not run it: 'the :8084 slot went to Phi-3.5-mini instead, which was the more valuable use of it. Parity here is a single point estimate (1.066x), not a bracket.' This run is that owed arm. It changes nothing else.

this_is_a_bracket_not_a_new_experiment.what_moves: arm A only: Q6_K_M (5.449 GiB) -> Q4_K_M (4.683 GiB), same family, same flags, same stem code path
this_is_a_bracket_not_a_new_experiment.what_is_held_frozen: arm B is adopted verbatim from equal-budget-002.raw.json via tools/equal_budget_check.py --reuse-arm-b; the tool refuses the donor unless suite, row count and member URLs match one for one
this_is_a_bracket_not_a_new_experiment.why_holding_it_matters: re-harvesting the held arm would re-roll it (a timeout or a sampler decision on the second pass), and a between-runs delta would then be read as a between-arms delta

host.note: swap was 95.9% used when this was written; the sequencing below still lowers the model-server weight below today's

arm_a_bracket.role: one big model, alone, on the far side of the committee's budget
arm_a_bracket.transient_stem: http://127.0.0.1:8771 (transient, started WITHOUT --root so no sentinel sees a new node)
arm_a_bracket.server_flags: identical to the live Q6 launcher (~/.pandosi/bin/llm-8b.sh) apart from -m and --port: --jinja --chat-template-kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} -ngl 99 -c 4096 --parallel 1 --temp 0

arm_b.role: the same committee, its votes taken from 002 rather than re-asked
arm_b.note: these members were harvested 2026-10-19 03:34-03:43; the suite bytes are re-verified above, so the question is identical even though the wall clock is not

budget_relation.reading: arm B carries 109.2% of the bracket's weight, so THE COMMITTEE IS BUDGET-FAVOURED BY 9.2% in this run -- the mirror image of 002, where arm B was handicapped by 6.2%. Together the two runs bracket parity instead of asserting it.

memory_sequencing_decision.hard_constraint: this Mac is not to carry a fourth concurrent local model
memory_sequencing_decision.decision: the live 8B Q6 server and its stem are booted out for the duration and restored afterwards with the same labels; the Q4 server and its stem are transient processes owned by this run, created with no launchd job
memory_sequencing_decision.count_check: today: Q6 + 4B + laya = 3 model servers, ~8.65 GiB of weights. bracket: Q4 + 4B + laya = 3 model servers, ~7.89 GiB. never more than today, and ~0.75 GiB less
memory_sequencing_decision.proposer_continuity: thinkd has --fallback-base-url :8080, so booting the 8B out degrades the proposer to the 4B rather than stalling it
memory_sequencing_decision.cost_accepted: the mac 8B member (mac-llm-8b-local, role=proposal, so not a voter) is offline for the duration; no quorum is affected

endpoints.metric: accuracy on the same 360 rows is the primary endpoint; the paired d on rows both arms answered is the decision statistic
endpoints.not_comparable: latency is reported but is NOT a between-arm endpoint -- the two arms were harvested in different residency configurations and at different times

decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.same_as_002: d = (B right, A wrong) - (A right, B wrong) over rows both answered; |d| > 1.96*SE to claim a winner
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.d<=0: a single Qwen3-8B-Q4_K_M wins while carrying LESS memory than the 4-member committee: the many-small-at-equal-budget claim is refuted on this family, not merely unsupported
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.d>0 and |d|>1.96*SE: the committee beats a same-family single model that has less memory than it does, so the 002 verdict is budget-sensitive rather than a property of committees
decision_rule_fixed_before_the_run.otherwise: inconclusive at this n; the 002 point estimate stays unbracketed

pre_committed_caveats: internal labels only: every expected label comes from this project's own generation pipeline, so nothing here is externally anchored
arm A and arm B share the Qwen3 family and tokenizer (arm B contains Qwen3-4B); a same-family bracket cannot speak to different-bloodline big models
one host, one prompt path, one temperature (0.0), no per-arm tuning, no split selection after the fact
this run still has no single-4B arm and no majority-of-two arm as pre-registered baselines; those remain owed
a Q4 bracket is a *weaker model* at lower memory, so a committee loss here is not the same statement as a committee loss to Q6
